name: xtremax
description: Claude Code plugins for extreme value analysis in JAX and NumPyro on xtremax.

plugins.name: xtremax
plugins.description: Build extreme value analyses on xtremax (NumPyro GEV / GPD / Gumbel / Fréchet / Weibull distributions, stable pure-JAX primitives, return levels, point processes, xarray block maxima, thresholds and declustering) instead of re-implementing them: an extreme-value-analysis skill and a reuse reviewer.
